def lookup(connection, name):
    return connection.execute("SELECT name FROM users WHERE name = ?", (name,)).fetchall()

findings.summary: Function definition lacks type annotations and a docstring.
findings.suggested_action: Add type annotations (e.g. connection: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> list[tuple[Any, ...]] and a descriptive docstring per PEP 8 and PEP 257.

limitations: No repository-wide linter or formatter configuration was provided.
